name.zh: 有栖院凪揭露为黑蔷薇
name.en: Nagi Arisuin Revealed as Black Rose

periods.location: Deserted area under a highway overpass
periods.summary: While Hagun celebrates its representatives, Nagi speaks by a non-Hagun student handbook with an Akatsuki contact. The caller identifies him as the Killing House's top graduate, formerly Black Shadow Killer and now Black Rose, and says Akatsuki's pre-festival preparations are complete.
periods.cause: Akatsuki is preparing to reveal itself as the true protagonist of the coming Seven Stars Festival events.
periods.process: The contact notes that Toka, Renren and Shizuku failed to qualify, but Nagi says the plan can proceed. His gentle school persona is replaced by a cold assassin-like expression.
periods.outcome: Akatsuki declares that the actors are assembled and that it will make the world notice its true main characters.
periods.significance: Major twist revealing a trusted friend as an Akatsuki infiltrator and launching the national-arc conflict.
